title: Support
subtitle: Every message people send AFC, and the replies that go back.
search: Search name, email, ticket or text
empty: No tickets match this view yet.
pickOne: Pick a ticket on the left to read it.
noAccess: You do not have access to the support desk. Ask a head admin for the support role.

composer.staffPlaceholder: Write your reply. They get it by email, and on Discord when we have it.
composer.limits: Up to 6 files, 20 MB each. Pictures, video or documents.

reply.sentWithDiscord: Reply sent by email and on Discord.
reply.explainer: Your reply goes to their email and, when they have Discord connected, as a message from the AFC bot. Everything here is kept on the ticket.

errors.queue: We could not load the tickets.
errors.ticket: We could not open that ticket.

audit.title: Support audit
audit.subtitle: Every message in either direction, every file, with the exact date and time.
audit.noAccess: Only head admins can open the support audit.
audit.search: Search text, ticket, name or email

public.title: Your support ticket
public.subtitle: Read the conversation and add anything you forgot, files included.
public.notFound: We could not find that ticket. Check the link in your email, or write to us again from the Contact page.
public.explainer: Anything you add here reaches the AFC team handling your ticket. Keep this link: it is how you get back to this page.

helpLog.title: Help log
helpLog.subtitle: Every question and request typed into the Help panel, answered or not, kept 90 days.
helpLog.search: Search what was typed or answered
helpLog.empty: Nothing typed into the Help panel yet.
helpLog.failed: Could not load the Help log.
helpLog.noAccess: Only support staff can read the Help log.
helpLog.nothingTyped: Nothing typed (a ticket from the chat alone)

desk.subtitle: Every message people send AFC, grouped by person: all of somebody's requests and files in one place, answered together or one at a time.
desk.search: Name, email, ticket number or words
desk.counts: {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}, {open, plural, one {# open request} other {# open requests}}
desk.requests: {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}, {open} open
desk.picked: {count, plural, one {# person picked} other {# people picked}}
desk.allRequests: {count, plural, one {The request from {name}} other {All # requests from {name}}}
desk.placeholder: Write to {name}. They get it by email, in My tickets on the site, and on Discord if connected.
desk.hintAll: One message to {name}, recorded on all {count} requests, so nobody has to answer the same question twice.
desk.allResolved: Every request from {name} is resolved. A new message brings them back here.
desk.empty: Nothing is waiting. New messages appear here as they arrive.
desk.noMatch: Nobody matches these filters. Clear a filter to see more.
desk.pickPerson: Pick a person on the left to read everything they sent.
desk.sentMany: Sent once by email, recorded on {count} requests.
desk.assignedToYou: Their open requests are assigned to you.

bulk.title: {count, plural, one {Reply to # person} other {Reply to # people}}

bulk.skipped: {count, plural, one {# person had} other {# people had}} nothing open and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} skipped.
